idiom-31-q41.truthCondition: The counsellor asked why two sisters had argued angrily almost daily since their grandmother visited.
idiom-31-q41.correctReason: 正確句保留輔導員追問原因，以及祖母來訪後兩姊妹持續激烈爭吵的時間線。

foils.text: The counsellor asked why the two sisters had been fighting like cat and dog before their grandmother's visit.
foils.reason: 「before」把爭吵移到祖母來訪之前；原題說由祖母來訪後開始。

foils.text: The counsellor asked why the two sisters had been fighting like cat and dog since their father's visit.
foils.reason: 「father's visit」把時間起點由祖母來訪改成父親來訪。

foils.text: The counsellor asked why the two sisters had stopped arguing after their grandmother's visit.
foils.reason: 「stopped arguing」說爭吵已停止；原題說來訪後幾乎每天仍在爭吵。

idiom-31-q42.truthCondition: Noah and Leo smile for family photos but begin angry arguments immediately once the camera is put away.
idiom-31-q42.correctReason: 「Not really」否定只憑照片判斷兩人融洽；正確句保留相機一收起便開始爭吵。

foils.text: Not really; Noah and Leo stop fighting like cat and dog as soon as the camera is put away.
foils.reason: 「stop」說收起相機時爭吵停止；原題說兩人那時才開始爭吵。

foils.text: Not really; Noah and Leo fight like cat and dog before the camera is put away.
foils.reason: 「before」把爭吵放在相機收起之前；原題說一收起便開始。

foils.text: Noah and Leo look angry in every family photo, then fight like cat and dog when the camera is put away.
foils.reason: 「look angry in every family photo」改變了原題說兩人在每張家庭照片中都面帶笑容。

idiom-31-q43.truthCondition: If Olivia and her cousin fail to listen, they may keep arguing angrily over every family decision.
idiom-31-q43.correctReason: 正確句保留「若不學會聆聽」的條件、「可能繼續」的語氣，以及每個家庭決定的爭議範圍。

foils.text: If Olivia and her cousin learn to listen, they may continue fighting like cat and dog over every family decision.
foils.reason: 「learn to listen」把原題的未學會聆聽改成已學會，倒轉了觸發條件。

foils.text: If Olivia and her cousin do not learn to listen, they must fight like cat and dog over every family decision.
foils.reason: 「must」把原題的可能繼續爭吵改成必然。

foils.text: If Olivia and her cousin do not learn to listen, they may stop arguing over every family decision.
foils.reason: 「stop arguing」把可能繼續爭吵改成可能停止爭吵。

idiom-31-q44.truthCondition: The club leader assigned Max and Henry separate roles because they had argued fiercely on earlier projects.
idiom-31-q44.correctReason: 正確句保留過往項目的激烈爭吵是這次分配不同工作的原因。

foils.text: The club leader gave Max and Henry separate roles because they had cooperated smoothly on earlier projects.

idiom-31-q45.correctReason: 「Even though」保留答應冷靜與很快再次激烈爭吵的反差；「again」對應原題的「又」。

After promising to be calmer, the two neighbours stopped fighting like cat and dog over the rubbish bins.
